text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Racun Makhluk Perosak

(Pengecualian) 2020.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa bagi tempoh mulai 15 Januari 2020

hingga 15 Januari 2025.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri mengecualikan mana-mana orang yang menggunakan racun makhluk

perosak daripada kehendak untuk menggunakan mengikut penggunaan, sebagaimana

yang diluluskan oleh Lembaga di bawah perenggan 53A(1)(b) Akta, yang dinyatakan pada

label, tertakluk kepada syarat yang berikut:

(a) penggunaan racun makhluk perosak hendaklah terhad kepada pengawalan

Kumbang Merah Palma (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus dan Rhynchophorus

vulneratus) yang merupakan perosak yang terdapat pada tanaman kelapa,

palma hiasan dan jenis tanaman palma yang lain; dan

(b) penggunaan racun makhluk perosak hendaklah terhad kepada racun

makhluk perosak yang mengandungi perawis aktif mengikut perumusan

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

(1)

Bil.

(2)

Perawis Aktif

(3)

Perumusan

1. cypermethrin pekatan teremulsi (EC))

2. cypermethrin emulsi, minyak dalam air (EW)

3. carbofuran butir (GR)

4. imidacloprid pekatan larut air (SL) atau pekatan ampaian

(SC)

5. lambda-cyhalothrin pekatan teremulsi (EC)

6. chlorpyrifos pekatan teremulsi (EC)

7. beta-cyfluthrin pekatan teremulsi (EC)

8. dinotefuran serbuk bancuh (WP)

9. thiamethoxam pekatan ampaian (SC)

DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

Menteri Pertanian dan Industri Asas Tani

Dibuat 6 Januari 2020

[KP/LA/483/11 Jld. 10; PN(PU2)275/XXII]

PESTICIDES ACT 1974

PESTICIDES (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 59 of the

Pesticides Act 1974 [Act 149], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Pesticides (Exemption) Order 2020.

(2) This Order has effect for the period from 15 January 2020

to 15 January 2025.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts any person who uses pesticides from the requirement to

use in accordance with the uses, as approved by the Board under paragraph 53A(1)(b) of

the Act, stipulated on the label, subject to the following conditions:

(a) the use of pesticides shall be limited to the control of Red Palm Weevils

(Rhynchophorus ferrugineus and Rhynchophorus vulneratus) which are

pests found on coconut plant, ornamental palm and other types of palm

plants; and

(b) the use of pesticides shall be limited to pesticides which contain active

ingredients according to the formulation, as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

(1)

No.

(2)

Active ingredient

(3)

Formulation

1. cypermethrin emulsifiable concentrate (EC)

2. cypermethrin emulsion, oil in water (EW)

3. carbofuran granule (GR)

4. imidacloprid soluble liquid (SL) or suspension

concentrate (SC)

5. lambda-cyhalothrin emulsifiable concentrate (EC)

6. chlorpyrifos emulsifiable concentrate (EC)

7. beta-cyfluthrin emulsifiable concentrate (EC)

8. dinotefuran wettable powder (WP)

9. thiamethoxam suspension concentrate (SC)

 DATUK SERI SALAHUDDIN BIN AYUB

 Minister of Agriculture and Agro-based Industry

Made 6 January 2020

[KP/LA/483/11 Jld. 10; PN(PU2)275/XXII]
